purpose: Define the strict Stage1->Stage2->Stage3 certification path without Python/compiler-bootstrap delegation, with content-bound Stage1 evidence, freestanding static artifacts, and exact fixed-point reproducibility.

artifact_construction.stage2: execute Stage1 compiler on exact canonical source -> assembly -> host assembler/linker -> static ELF
artifact_construction.stage3: execute Stage2 compiler on same exact canonical source -> assembly -> identical host assembler/linker recipe -> static ELF
artifact_construction.host_object: compile stage1_host_io.c exactly once and reuse the identical object for Stage2 and Stage3 linking
prohibited: PT_INTERP or dynamically loaded Stage2/Stage3 compiler artifact

pythonless_compiler_runtime.strict_runtime_proof: strace -f: exactly one compiler execve, no descendant execve, and no file access targeting repository checkout, bootstrap, Python source/bytecode/archive, Python stdlib/package directories, or libpython shared runtime. Relative file opens fail closed. Absolute paths are resolved before checkout comparison.
pythonless_compiler_runtime.filesystem_inaccessible_proof: Landlock replay for Stage1->Stage2 and Stage2->Stage3 must independently PASS; trace-only fallback cannot authorize FULL_SELF_HOSTING.
pythonless_compiler_runtime.strace_or_landlock_missing: blocks strict FULL_SELF_HOSTING certification rather than silently downgrading proof

determinism.optional_stage4: Stage3 may compile the same source to Stage4 as an additional fixed-point confirmation

fail_closed: Stage1 gate v2 missing or inconsistent
any hashed Stage1 evidence role fails revalidation

compiler opens repository/bootstrap/Python source or bytecode
compiler opens Python stdlib/package paths or libpython shared runtime
strace unavailable or required syscall trace unsupported

Stage2 or Stage3 artifact is not freestanding static ELF
